Two identical, harmless banners come from your own computer. One uses a normal address; the other uses an address matched by an EasyList image rule. No real advertisements or trackers are involved.

Use the Chrome profile where NAAB is installed. Leave Privacy Badger and other blockers off for both runs. EasyList must be downloaded in NAAB.

1. Switch Global protection off in NAAB's Lists & diagnostics, then reload this page. Both banners should appear.

2. Switch Global protection on, then reload this page. The normal banner should remain and the ad-pattern banner should disappear.
